speaker: Brenda Okoro
cascadeSummary: We're clearing Month-Six disbursement and launching canvass in West Oakland on schedule — fifty-seven households stabilized so far, outreach reset targeting slipping blocks. Ivy Hill's progress belongs to the residents; KONO's energy is driver momentum.

statements.decision: Proceed with Month-Six disbursement + launch canvass targeting slipping blocks
statements.quote: Fifty-seven households stabilized means fifty-seven families breathing easier — but West Oakland's storefronts tell me we're resetting outreach two cycles late. We're hitting the streets this cycle to find the next fifty-seven, because stability shouldn't be a waiting list.
statements.fullStatement: This cycle we're clearing the Month-Six disbursement batch and launching a canvass targeting West Oakland's slipping blocks. Fifty-seven households stabilized so far means fifty-seven families breathing easier — but West Oakland's storefronts tell me we're resetting outreach two cycles late. We're hitting the streets this cycle to find the next fifty-seven, because stability shouldn't be a waiting list. Outreach will focus on the neighborhoods where displacement is winning — we know which blocks, we can name landlords, we're putting feet on the ground.

statements.topic: KONO and Ivy Hill — Crisis and Credit
statements.decision: Credit Ivy Hill's progress to residents; name KONO's energy as driver momentum
statements.quote: KONO's energy is real, and Ivy Hill's progress belongs to the people who live there — resilience is their story, not ours.
statements.fullStatement: KONO's energy is real — street trade busy, crime low, momentum building. What drives that energy belongs to the people who live there, not this office. Ivy Hill's progress is a testament to the resilience of its people — resilience is their story, not ours. Our role is operational — making sure the systems that support their momentum stay strong.
